items.spec: Two fused metaballs, #1d7f1c on a #f701e5 background. Blob A is centered at (0.126, -0.239) with radius parameter 0.189; blob B at (-0.138, -0.453) with radius parameter 0.101 (p coordinates: image-height units from the center, +x right, +y up). A pixel is #1d7f1c where r1^2/|p-A|^2 + r2^2/|p-B|^2 >= 1.

Two fused metaballs, #f4ac52 on a #20cf82 background. Blob A is centered at (-0.084, 0.142) with radius parameter 0.167; blob B at (-0.463, 0.074) with radius parameter 0.091 (p coordinates: image-height units from the center, +x right, +y up). A pixel is #f4ac52 where r1^2/|p-A|^2 + r2^2/|p-B|^2 >= 1.

Two fused metaballs, #11c2d0 on a #c8d07d background. Blob A is centered at (-0.156, 0.131) with radius parameter 0.139; blob B at (0.079, 0.408) with radius parameter 0.15 (p coordinates: image-height units from the center, +x right, +y up). A pixel is #11c2d0 where r1^2/|p-A|^2 + r2^2/|p-B|^2 >= 1.

A 2-armed spiral centered on the image alternating #990f44 and #61f12e. With r the distance from the center in image-height units and theta = atan2(y, x), the phase is 2 * theta / (2*pi) + 3.106 * r; where fract(phase) < 0.5 the color is #990f44, otherwise #61f12e. Finally apply a vignette: multiply the whole color by 1 - 0.396 * smoothstep(0.2, 0.7, r), where r is the distance from the image center in image-height units.

A 3-armed spiral centered on the image alternating #e4ede2 and #2f2e94. With r the distance from the center in image-height units and theta = atan2(y, x), the phase is 3 * theta / (2*pi) + 4.794 * r; where fract(phase) < 0.5 the color is #e4ede2, otherwise #2f2e94. Finally apply a vignette: multiply the whole color by 1 - 0.649 * smoothstep(0.2, 0.7, r), where r is the distance from the image center in image-height units.

A 3-armed spiral centered on the image alternating #5b27f2 and #8a833c. With r the distance from the center in image-height units and theta = atan2(y, x), the phase is 3 * theta / (2*pi) + 4.633 * r; where fract(phase) < 0.5 the color is #5b27f2, otherwise #8a833c.

Wavy vertical stripes: 9 stripes across the image alternating #3db100 and #eefcf2. With u, v in [0,1] (v from the bottom), the stripe index is floor(9 * (u + 0.05 * sin(2*pi*3*v))); even indices are #3db100, odd indices are #eefcf2.

Wavy vertical stripes: 7 stripes across the image alternating #d76df2 and #d8e30c. With u, v in [0,1] (v from the bottom), the stripe index is floor(7 * (u + 0.044 * sin(2*pi*3*v))); even indices are #d76df2, odd indices are #d8e30c. Finally draw a solid #ddf9ca frame around the image: every pixel closer than 0.036 (in uv units, i.e. fraction of the image side) to any image edge becomes #ddf9ca.

Wavy vertical stripes: 8 stripes across the image alternating #682983 and #d504bf. With u, v in [0,1] (v from the bottom), the stripe index is floor(8 * (u + 0.045 * sin(2*pi*2*v))); even indices are #682983, odd indices are #d504bf.
